decisions.reason: After four years with no later website visibility, this niche search plugin no longer looks like an unresolved option, and its likely overlap with other search offerings makes reallocation of resources more sensible.
Although it addressed a real mobile usability need in the core domain, the lack of visible follow-on traction by 2020-2021 suggests the standalone component has limited remaining option value.
As the firm's flagship GIS platform and a product closely tied to its strategic direction, it remains worth keeping despite some uncertainty and reduced public visibility.

Mobile field data capture fits the portfolio, but after several years without visible evidence of market momentum the uncertainty has largely resolved and the firm would likely concentrate on stronger core offerings.
This web-map search extension is inexpensive to maintain but appears non-core and potentially duplicative, so with weak later visibility it is a natural candidate for consolidation and exit.
